maria: quick sync 3: need to finalize capacity metering approach for Dedicated: reserved SKUs, burst ledger semantics, and autoscale cooldowns. aiming to bake into Q3 roadmap doc.
ajay: proposal: SKUs = micro, team, enterprise (1, 4, 32 GPU-eq). Each SKU gets a burst window and default soft quota behavior.
ben: infra notes: cold-boot for large models ~2-4min; draining caches ~25-40s. recommend scale cooldown >= 180s, and prefer scale-up smoothing 45s.
tal: UX: customers hate opaque credits. show a "burst ledger" in Console with current window, consumed, and carryover flag. Carryover must be explicit opt-in.
sophia: finance/legal: prefer USD-minutes as billing unit. Carryover requires opt-in + audit record. Also need a clear refund policy for unused purchased burst.
lee: support perspective: soft quota + 429 with human-readable guidance is better than silent drops. Also add a fallback route to smaller-model variants when enterprise quota exhausted.
ajay: burst window suggestion: micro=10m, team=30m, enterprise=24h with optional monthly carryover. That 24h window helps batchy enterprise.
ben: minimal autoscale config example we can start with:
```
cooldown: 180s
scale_up_sample: 60s
preempt_policy: opportunistic-first
soft_quota: true
```
maria: decision checklist for roadmap: 1) SKUs (micro/team/enterprise) 2) tiered burst windows as Ajay suggested 3) carryover = opt-in only for enterprise 4) soft-quota default, hard-enforce via contract 5) cooldown=180s.
ops-bot: event created: Dedicated Metering Review Thu 9:30. Invite sent.
maria: action items: Ben -> dev estimate + migration notes by Mon EOD; Ajay -> pricing bands + SLOs; Tal -> Console mock + ledger copy by Tue; Sophia -> legal/billing language; Lee -> support playbook draft. Review Thu 9:30. Any objections?
ajay: no objections.
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
